{{quote|There is much ji in her decision. She will bend her enemies to her will, not run from them. I wish you well in your dance, Egwene al'Vere.| [[Amys]] }}

== Summary ==

:{{pov|[[Egwene al'Vere]]}}
Egwene prepares for bed with assistance from her maid, [[Selame]]. She looks out the tent window and sees a woman watching the tent.{{ref|Probably [[Halima]].}} She puts herself to sleep the way the [[Wise One]]s taught her and enters the [[Tel'aran'rhiod|World of Dreams]]. She warns [[Nynaeve]] and [[Elayne]] about the blackmail attempt by [[Nicola]], and also about the escape of [[Moghedien]], by passing a message to them in their dreams. She then finds [[Amys]] and makes a request to meet her, which is accepted. [[Gawyn]]'s dream almost catches her, but she moves to the meeting place in the [[Stone of Tear]] to wait for the Wise Ones.

[[Amys]], [[Bair]], and [[Melaine]] arrive and sit down beside ''[[Callandor]]'' to hear what Egwene has to say. She informs them that she has been raised as [[Amyrlin]] to the [[Salidar|rebel faction]] of [[Aes Sedai]]. They correctly deduce that she may only be a figurehead rather than truly in command. The Wise Ones let Egwene know that [[Merana]] and the other Aes Sedai have traveled to [[Cairhien]] but did not bring pigeons so they can report back. They do not tell her about Rand's kidnapping by the [[White Tower]] Aes Sedai or that the Aes Sedai have sworn fealty to him.

Egwene dreams of Gawyn after she returns from ''[[Tel'aran'rhiod]]'', but they are a [[Egwene's dreams|Dreamer]]'s dreams not normal dreams.

* Gawyn walking barefoot across broken glass, his feet bleeding.{{ref|The choices Gawyn has made have caused him great pain.}}
* Gawyn on a horse faced with a choice of two paths. One path lead to his death, the other to a long life.{{ref|Gawyn deciding whether to stay with Egwene during the Last Battle to protect her or to put on the [[Night's Shade]] ''[[ter'angreal]]'' and challenge [[Demandred]].}}
* Mat reaching into the sky to grab exploding fireworks, which would lead to many deaths.{{ref|This is [[Aludra]]'s [[Dragons]].}}
* Egwene with her neck on a headman's block with an axe descending and someone rushing to save her{{ref|Probably Gawyn saving her from the [[Bloodknife|Bloodknives]].}}
* Logain stepping over Rand's body to mount a black stone{{ref|Probably Logain taking over the leadership of the [[Black Tower]] after the [[Last Battle]].}}
* A golden female hawk touches Egwene and they become tied together{{ref|Probably [[Egeanin Tamarath|Egeanin]] becoming Egwene's warder (a golden hawk probably means [[Seanchan]]).}}
* A man lies dying in a bed; it's important that he live, but a funeral pyre is prepared{{ref|Probably Rand after the [[Last Battle]].}}
* A dark young man holds a brightly shining object{{ref|Possibly ''Callandor'' or the male [[Access key]]. A dark young man may be Rand in Moridin's body.}}
